mapper.select:
/* selectMasterMdCmCmsMapppingList */ SELECT SEQ AS SEQ, MAP.BUYER AS BUYER, MAP.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO,
IT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS BUYER_DESC,
IT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS BUYER_DESC,
IT.DESCRIPTION AS BUYER_DESC,
IT.SPECIFICATION AS BUYER_SPEC, IT.MAKER_CODE AS BUYER_MAKER_CODE, IT.MAKER_NAME AS BUYER_MAKER_NAME, IT.ORIGIN_CODE AS BUYER_ORIGIN_CODE, MAP.CMS_CATLG_ID AS CMS_CATLG_ID, DECODE (MAP.CMS_CATLG_ID, 'TALK', 'TALK', 'PASS', 'PASS', CMS.STD_FLAG) AS STD_FLAG, CMS.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS CMS_DESC, CMS.SPECIFICATION AS CMS_SPEC, CMS.MAKER_NAME AS CMS_MAKER_NAME, CMS.MAKER_CODE AS CMS_MAKER_CODE, CMS.ORIGIN_CODE AS CMS_ORIGIN_CODE, MAP.USER_ID AS USER_ID, MAP.REFER_MAPPING_FLAG AS REFER_MAPPING_FLAG FROM CMSMAPPING MAP,
ICOMBYIT IT,
ITEMMAST IT,
MALLCQDT IT,
CMSCATLG CMS WHERE MAP.CMS_CATLG_ID = CMS.CMS_CATLG_ID(+)
AND MAP.BUYER = IT.BUYER(+) AND MAP.BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+)
AND MAP.BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.STDCATLG_ID(+)
AND MAP.BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.ITEM_NO(+)
mapper.update: UPDATE ICOMBYIT IT SET CMS_CATLG_ID = (SELECT MAX(TRIM (CMS_CATLG_ID)) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER = IT.BUYER AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO), CMS_CATEG_ID = DECODE ( (SELECT CMS_CATEG_ID FROM CMSCATLG WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = (SELECT MAX(TRIM (CMS_CATLG_ID)) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER = IT.BUYER AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO)), NULL, CMS_CATEG_ID, (SELECT CMS_CATEG_ID FROM CMSCATLG WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = (SELECT MAX(TRIM (CMS_CATLG_ID)) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER = IT.BUYER AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO))), CMS_USER_ID = (SELECT MAX(TRIM (USER_ID)) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER = IT.BUYER AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO), CMS_DATE = TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE (BUYER, BUYER_ITEM_NO) IN (SELECT BUYER, BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM CMSMAPPING)

UPDATE ITEMMAST IT SET CMS_CATLG_ID = (SELECT TRIM (CMS_CATLG_ID) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.STDCATLG_ID), CMS_CATEG_ID = DECODE ( (SELECT CMS_CATEG_ID FROM CMSCATLG WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = (SELECT TRIM (CMS_CATLG_ID) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.STDCATLG_ID)), NULL, CMS_CATEG_ID, (SELECT CMS_CATEG_ID FROM CMSCATLG WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = (SELECT TRIM (CMS_CATLG_ID) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.STDCATLG_ID))), CMS_USER_ID = (SELECT TRIM (USER_ID) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.STDCATLG_ID), CMS_DATE = TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE STDCATLG_ID IN (SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM CMSMAPPING)

UPDATE MALLCQDT IT SET CMS_CATLG_ID = (SELECT TRIM (CMS_CATLG_ID) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.ITEM_NO), CMS_CATEG_ID = DECODE ( (SELECT CMS_CATEG_ID FROM CMSCATLG WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = (SELECT TRIM (CMS_CATLG_ID) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.ITEM_NO)), NULL, CMS_CATEG_ID, (SELECT CMS_CATEG_ID FROM CMSCATLG WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = (SELECT TRIM (CMS_CATLG_ID) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.ITEM_NO))), CMS_USER_ID = (SELECT TRIM (USER_ID) FROM CMSMAPPING WHERE BUYER_ITEM_NO = IT.ITEM_NO), CMS_DATE = TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE ITEM_NO IN (SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM CMSMAPPING)

INSERT INTO CMSMAPPING (SEQ, BUYER, BUYER_ITEM_NO, CMS_CATLG_ID, USER_ID, REFER_MAPPING_FLAG) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX (TO_NUMBER (SEQ)), 0)+1 AS SEQ FROM CMSMAPPING), UPPER (#{BUYER}), #{BUYER_ITEM_NO}, UPPER (#{CMS_CATLG_ID}), UPPER (#{USER_ID}), UPPER (#{REFER_MAPPING_FLAG}))
